title: iFISH:a publically available resource enabling versatile DNA FISH to study genome architecture
protocol: Mix forward primer (12.5 μM) 3 μL in a PCR tube or 96-well plate.
Mix reverse primer (12.5 μM) 3 μL with the forward primer.
Add oligo-pool (10 nM) 2 μL to the mixture.
Combine SYBR master mix (2x) 12.5 μL with the previous components.
Add nuclease-free water 4.5 μL to complete the reaction mix.
Prepare a master mix containing SYBR master mix and nuclease-free water for high throughput.
Dispense forward primer (12.5 μM) 3 μL into each well using multichannel pipettes or a liquid handling robot.
Dispense reverse primer (12.5 μM) 3 μL into the corresponding wells along with the forward primers.
Add oligo-pool (10 nM) 2 μL to the respective wells for amplification of specific probes.
Combine SYBR master mix (2x) 12.5 μL and nuclease-free water 4.5 μL in each well.
Transfer the complete reaction mixture into the PCR instrument for amplification.
Pre-warm the beads for at least 30 min at room temperature (rt).
Transfer the PCR product into a 1.5 ml DNA Lobind tube.
Pipette the bead solution gently to achieve homogeneous suspension before use. Add bead suspension with 1.8x the volume of the PCR product.
Mix well and incubate 5 min at rt.
Place the reaction tube onto a DynaMagTM magnetic rack and wait for 5 min at rt until the beads clearly separate from the solution.
Slowly aspirate the cleared solution and discard it. This step must be performed while the reaction tube is still on the magnetic rack. Do not disturb the separated magnetic beads.
Add 100 μL of 70% ethanol to the tube.
Incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Aspirate the ethanol and discard it while the tube is still on the magnetic rack.
Do not disturb the separated magnetic beads.
Remove all of the ethanol from the tube.
Open the lid of the tube and let the beads air-dry for 10 minutes.
Add 40 μL of RNase-free water to the tube.
Pipette-mix at least 10 times.
Incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place the reaction tube on the magnetic rack for 1 minute until the beads separate from the solution.
Transfer the eluate to a new tube.
Measure dsDNA concentration using Qubit.
Transfer the PCR products to a 96-well plate.
Pipette the bead solution gently to achieve homogeneous suspension before use.
Add bead suspension with 1.8x the volume of the PCR product into each well.
Mix well and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place the reaction plate onto an Agencourt SPRIPlate 96 Super Magnet Plate and wait for 5 minutes at room temperature until the beads clearly separate from the solution.

Slowly aspirate the cleared solution from the reaction plate and discard it. This step must be performed while the reaction plate is still on the magnetic rack. Do not disturb the ring of separated magnetic beads.
Add 100 μL of 70% ethanol to each well of the reaction plate and incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Aspirate the ethanol and discard it while the plate is still on the magnetic rack. Do not disturb the ring of separated magnetic beads. Be sure to remove all of the ethanol.
Let the reaction plate air-dry for 10 minutes. The beads should air-dry until the last visible traces of ethanol evaporate.
Add 40 μL of RNase-free water into each well, pipette-mix at least 10 times, incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place the reaction plate onto the Agencourt SPRIPlate 96 Super Magnet for 1 minute to separate beads from the solution.
Transfer the eluate to a new 96-well plate.
Measure dsDNA concentration using Qubit.
Prepare and mix the following solution: Template dsDNA 16.5 μL, TNP buffer (20 mM) 10 μL, RNAseOut (40 U/μL) 1.5 μL, T7 RNA polymerase mix* 2 μL.
Incubate the mixed solution at 37°C in a PCR cycler for 12-16 hours.
Add 20 μL nuclease-free water and 2 μL of DNase I to the IVT solution.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Transfer the IVT product into a 1.5 ml DNA Lobind tube.
Pipette the bead solution gently to achieve homogeneous suspension before use.
Add the bead suspension with 1.8x the volume of the PCR product.
Mix well and incubate 3-5 min at room temperature.
Place the reaction tube onto a DynaMag™ magnetic rack and wait for 5 min at room temperature until the beads clearly separate from the solution.
Slowly aspirate the cleared solution and discard it while the reaction tube is still on the magnetic rack. Do not disturb the separated magnetic beads.
Add 150 μL of 70% ethanol to the tube and incubate for 30 sec at room temperature.
Aspirate the ethanol and discard it while the tube is still on the magnetic rack. Do not disturb the separated magnetic beads. Be sure to remove all of the ethanol.
Open the lid of the tube, let the beads air-dry for 10 min until the last visible traces of ethanol evaporate.
Add 40 μL of RNase-free water to the tube.
Pipette-mix at least 10 times.
Incubate for 2 min at room temperature.
Place the reaction tube on the magnetic rack for 1 min until the beads separate from the solution.
Transfer the eluate into a new tube.
Measure RNA concentration using Qubit.
Transfer the PCR products into a 96-well plate.
Pipette the bead solution gently to achieve homogeneous suspension before use.
Add bead suspension with 1.8x the volume of the PCR product into each well.
Mix well and incubate 3-5 min at room temperature.
Place the reaction plate onto an Agencourt SPRIPlate 96 Super Magnet Plate and wait for 5 min at room temperature until the beads clearly separate from the solution.
Slowly aspirate the cleared solution and discard while the reaction tube is situated on the magnetic rack without disturbing the separated magnetic beads.
Add 150 μL of 70% ethanol to each well of the reaction plate.
Incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Aspirate and discard ethanol while the plate is situated on an Agencourt SPRIPlate 96 Super Magnet Plate.
Let the reaction plate air-dry for 10 minutes until all visible traces of ethanol evaporate.
Add 40 μL of RNase-free water to each well.
Pipette mix at least 10 times.
Incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place the reaction plate onto the Agencourt SPRIPlate 96 Super Magnet for 1 minute to separate beads from solution.
Measure RNA concentration using Qubit.
Mix dNTP mix (10 mM) at a volume of 3 μL.
Pipette forward primer (100 μM) at a volume of 4 μL.
Add RT buffer (5x) at a volume of 4 μL.
Add Maxima H reverse transcriptase (200U/μL) at a volume of 1 μL.
Add RNaseOut (40U/μL) at a volume of 1 μL.
Mix template RNA at a volume of 7 μL into the solution last.
Incubate the solution at 50°C for 1 hour.
Terminate the reaction by heating to 85°C for 5 minutes.
Add 20 μL of 0.5M EDTA and 20 μL of 1N NaOH to the RT product.
Incubate at 95°C in a PCR cycler for 15 minutes.
Place the reactions on ice to cool down before proceeding.
Add oligo binding buffer at a volume of 120 μL to the RT product.
Add 100% EtOH at a volume of 480 μL to the RT product.
Mix well and transfer the entire volume into a Zymo Spin IC column.
Centrifuge at 10,000g for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.
Wash the column with 750 μL of DNA wash buffer.
Centrifuge at 10,000g for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.
Elute the product using 40 μL of nuclease-free water.
Centrifuge at 10,000g for 1 minute.
Measure ssDNA concentration with Qubit and store the probe at -20°C.
Mix 20-100ng of ssDNA with 5 μL Novex TBE sample buffer.
Add 4 μL nuclease-free water to each sample.
Heat samples at 70°C for 3 min, then load on the gel immediately or store on ice until ready to load.
Load samples on the gel in the electrophoretic chamber pre-filled with TBE running buffer.
Perform electrophoresis at 50 V for 5 min, then increase to 180 V for at least 75 min.
Dilute SYBR Green 1:10,000 in TBE running buffer (1 µL in 10 mL).
Incubate diluted SYBR Green on a shaker for 15 min.
Image the gel to confirm the length of the probes before proceeding to FISH.
